rationale: Both candidates independently surface the real cross-file issue behind the ground-truth 'do not change this' on musa.inc.md — the new compatibility admonition contradicts musa.inc.md's still-0.18.0-dev pin — but Y states it as a single tight, well-evidenced finding while X buries it in a longer essay. Y also correctly validates the npu.inc.md releases/v0.26.0rc branch via GitHub API, matching the actual FayeSpica LGTM outcome, whereas X flags that same line as an unresolved risk needing confirmation, effectively second-guessing something reviewers already approved; Y also notes quickstart.md was intentionally left unchanged, covering all three ground-truth threads, while X never mentions quickstart.md at all. X is considerably more thorough and its suggestions are more concretely actionable (code snippets, exact commands), but several of its extra findings (RC-branch doubt, npu cd-anchor speculation, URL-convention nit) are speculative or moot given the actual review outcome, pulling down precision relative to Y's leaner, more accurate set.
